repo.description:
### Impact

An authenticated user can bypass an administrator-configured user-enumeration restriction and enumerate users outside their allowed group scope, disclosing other groups' user identifiers, display names, and email addresses.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Mail app is upgraded to 3.7.25 or 5.5.16 or 5.6.20 or  5.7.13

### Workarounds

* Disable Mail app

### References

<!-- Link to the main/master PR only -->

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3617729)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/mail/pull/12715)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: Mail contact autocomplete bypasses administrator-configured user enumeration restrictions
